arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Ortiz argued the case concerns who counts as a supervisor. He stated the side that brought the case's position on the legal standard.
Mr. Garre argued the lower court's judgment should stand. He claimed the record showed the employees lacked supervisory authority.
Ms. Davis described specific incidents. She mentioned an elevator block and alleged use of racial slurs.
Justice Alito questioned the clarity of the proposed legal standard. He noted courts might struggle to apply it consistently.
